fr.L: Six jours tu travailleras, et le septième jour tu te reposeras ; au [temps du] labour et à la moisson tu te reposeras.
fr.B: Pendant six jours, tu pourras faire ton travail, mais le septième jour, tu le garderas comme jour de repos. Tu te reposeras même quand les champs attendent la charrue ou que la moisson est mûre.
fr.R: Tu peux travailler pendant six jours, mais le septième jour, tu dois te reposer. Repose-toi ce jour-là même aux moments chargés où tu laboures tes champs et où tu rentres tes récoltes.

sw.L: Siku sita utafanya kazi, na siku ya saba utapumzika; [wakati wa] kulima na wakati wa mavuno utapumzika.
sw.B: Kwa siku sita unaweza kufanya kazi yako, lakini siku ya saba utaishika kuwa siku ya kupumzika. Pumzika hata mashamba yanapohitaji kulimwa au mavuno yanapokuwa tayari.
sw.R: Unaweza kufanya kazi kwa siku sita, lakini siku ya saba lazima upumzike. Pumzika siku hiyo hata wakati wa shughuli nyingi unapolima mashamba yako na kuvuna mazao yako.

decisions.choice: rest: stop work
decisions.reason: The verb means to cease, to stop working. The word Sabbath comes from it (16:30; 20:8-11; 23:12; 31:13-17).

decisions.choice: in plowing time and in harvest: even in the busiest seasons
decisions.reason: Plowing before the rains and harvest were the times farmers could least afford to stop. The Sabbath rest applies even then.

source.text: וְחַ֤ג שָׁבֻעֹת֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה לְךָ֔ בִּכּוּרֵ֖י קְצִ֣יר חִטִּ֑ים וְחַג֙ הָֽאָסִ֔יף תְּקוּפַ֖ת הַשָּׁנָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And a festival of weeks you will observe for yourself, [the] first-fruits of [the] harvest of wheat, and the festival of the ingathering [at] the circuit of the year.

en.L: And a feast of weeks you shall keep for yourself, [with the] firstfruits of the wheat harvest, and the feast of ingathering [at] the turn of the year.
en.B: Keep the Feast of Weeks when the first of the wheat harvest comes in, and the Feast of Ingathering as the year comes round.
en.R: Celebrate the Festival of Weeks when you bring in the first of your wheat harvest. Celebrate the Festival of Ingathering at the end of the farming year, when you gather in your crops.

es.L: Y una fiesta de las Semanas celebrarás para ti, [con las] primicias de la siega del trigo, y la fiesta de la Recolección [a la] vuelta del año.
es.B: Celebrarás la fiesta de las Semanas cuando llegue lo primero de la cosecha del trigo, y la fiesta de la Recolección al cumplirse el ciclo del año.
es.R: Celebra la fiesta de las Semanas cuando recojas lo primero de tu cosecha de trigo. Celebra la fiesta de la Recolección al final del año agrícola, cuando recoges tus cosechas.

fr.L: Et une fête des Semaines, tu la célébreras pour toi, [avec les] prémices de la moisson du blé, et la fête de la Récolte [au] tournant de l’année.
fr.B: Tu célébreras la fête des Semaines quand arrivent les prémices de la moisson du blé, et la fête de la Récolte au tournant de l’année.
fr.R: Célèbre la fête des Semaines quand tu rentres le premier blé de ta moisson. Célèbre la fête de la Récolte à la fin de l’année agricole, quand tu rentres tes récoltes.

sw.L: Na sikukuu ya Majuma utaishika kwa ajili yako, [pamoja na] malimbuko ya mavuno ya ngano, na sikukuu ya Kukusanya Mazao [wakati wa] mzunguko wa mwaka.
sw.B: Utaishika Sikukuu ya Majuma mavuno ya kwanza ya ngano yanapoingia, na Sikukuu ya Kukusanya Mazao mwaka unapogeuka.
sw.R: Adhimisha Sikukuu ya Majuma unapoleta mavuno ya kwanza ya ngano yako. Adhimisha Sikukuu ya Kukusanya Mazao mwishoni mwa mwaka wa kilimo, unapokusanya mazao yako.

decisions.choice: the Feast of Weeks: the start of the wheat harvest
decisions.reason: The feast came seven weeks after the start of the grain harvest (Leviticus 23:15-16; Deuteronomy 16:9-10), in late spring. Later it was called Pentecost, the "fiftieth" day (Acts 2:1).

decisions.choice: the Feast of Ingathering at the turn of the year: the autumn harvest
decisions.reason: This feast came when the last crops, grapes, olives and other fruits, were gathered in, as the farming year came round to its end (23:16 says "at the going out of the year"). It is also called the Feast of Booths (Leviticus 23:34-43).

decisions.choice: at the end of the farming year, when you gather in your crops
decisions.reason: Readable explains "the turn of the year" and the name "Ingathering".

decisions.choice: Sikukuu ya Majuma
decisions.reason: "Majuma" is the standard written plural for weeks in the name of a feast; "wiki" is the everyday word. The Feast of Ingathering keeps the name used in 23:16, "Sikukuu ya Kukusanya Mazao".

source.text: שָׁלֹ֥שׁ פְּעָמִ֖ים בַּשָּׁנָ֑ה יֵרָאֶה֙ כָּל־זְכ֣וּרְךָ֔ אֶת־פְּנֵ֛י הָֽאָדֹ֥ן׀יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: Three times in the year he will present himself every male of yours before the face of the Lord Yahweh, the God of Israel.

en.L: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the face of the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel.
en.B: Three times a year every male among you is to appear before the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel.
en.R: Three times each year every male among you must come to worship the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel.

es.L: Tres veces en el año se presentará todo varón tuyo ante el rostro del Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel.
es.B: Tres veces al año todos tus varones se presentarán ante el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel.
es.R: Tres veces cada año, todos los varones de tu pueblo deben venir a adorar al Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel.

fr.L: Trois fois dans l’année, tout mâle chez toi paraîtra devant la face du Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël.
fr.B: Trois fois par an, tous tes hommes se présenteront devant le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël.
fr.R: Trois fois chaque année, tous les hommes de chez toi doivent venir adorer le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël.

sw.L: Mara tatu katika mwaka kila mwanamume wako ataonekana mbele ya uso wa Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli.
sw.B: Mara tatu kwa mwaka kila mwanamume miongoni mwako atajihudhurisha mbele ya Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli.
sw.R: Mara tatu kila mwaka, kila mwanamume miongoni mwako lazima aje kumwabudu Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli.

decisions.choice: three times in the year all your males: the three pilgrim feasts
decisions.reason: The three times are the feasts of verses 18 and 22 (23:14-17; Deuteronomy 16:16). The men went as heads of their households; women and children might also go (1 Samuel 1:3-7).

decisions.choice: the Lord Yahweh: the Master, Yahweh
decisions.reason: "The Lord" is a title meaning master, set before the divine name. Together they stress that Yahweh is Israel's sovereign, whose servants must come before him.

decisions.choice: the Lord GOD
decisions.reason: When the title "Lord" stands just before the divine name, the name is printed "GOD" to avoid "the Lord LORD"; the Yahweh setting gives "the Lord Yahweh".

source.text: כִּֽי־אוֹרִ֤ישׁ גּוֹיִם֙ מִפָּנֶ֔יךָ וְהִרְחַבְתִּ֖י אֶת־גְּבוּלֶ֑ךָ וְלֹא־יַחְמֹ֥ד אִישׁ֙ אֶֽת־אַרְצְךָ֔ בַּעֲלֹֽתְךָ֗ לֵרָאוֹת֙ אֶת־פְּנֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ שָׁלֹ֥שׁ פְּעָמִ֖ים בַּשָּׁנָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: For I will dispossess nations from before you and I will enlarge your territory, and not will covet anyone your land when you go up to present yourself before the face of Yahweh your God three times in the year.

en.L: For I will dispossess nations before you and enlarge your territory, and no one shall covet your land when you go up to appear before the face of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God three times in the year.
en.B: I will dispossess nations to make room for you and push your borders outward. And while you are away three times a year, going up to appear before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, no one will scheme to seize your land.
en.R: I will force nations out ahead of you and give you more land. Three times a year you will go to worship {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. While you are gone, no one will try to take your land.

es.L: Porque desposeeré naciones delante de ti y ensancharé tu territorio, y nadie codiciará tu tierra cuando subas a presentarte ante el rostro {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios tres veces en el año.
es.B: Desposeeré naciones para hacerte lugar y extenderé tus fronteras. Y mientras estés fuera tres veces al año, subiendo a presentarte ante {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios, nadie tramará apoderarse de tu tierra.
es.R: Echaré a otras naciones delante de ti y te daré más tierra. Tres veces al año irás a adorar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios. Mientras estés fuera, nadie intentará quitarte la tierra.

fr.L: Car je déposséderai des nations devant toi et j’élargirai ton territoire, et personne ne convoitera ton pays quand tu monteras pour paraître devant la face {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu trois fois dans l’année.
fr.B: Je déposséderai des nations pour te faire place et je reculerai tes frontières. Et pendant que tu seras parti, trois fois par an, pour monter te présenter devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu, personne ne complotera pour s’emparer de ton pays.
fr.R: Je vais chasser des nations devant toi et te donner plus de terre. Trois fois par an, tu iras adorer {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu. Pendant ton absence, personne n’essaiera de prendre ton pays.

sw.L: Kwa maana nitayafukuza mataifa mbele yako na kuipanua mipaka yako, wala hakuna mtu atakayetamani nchi yako unapopanda kuonekana mbele ya uso wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako mara tatu katika mwaka.
sw.B: Nitayaondoa mataifa ili kukupa nafasi, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitaisogeza mipaka yako mbali zaidi. Na wakati utakapokuwa safarini mara tatu kwa mwaka, ukienda kujihudhurisha mbele ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, hakuna mtu atakayepanga njama ya kuitwaa nchi yako.
sw.R: Nitayafukuza mataifa mbele yako na kukupa nchi kubwa zaidi. Mara tatu kwa mwaka utakwenda kumwabudu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako. Wakati huo hutakuwepo nyumbani, lakini hakuna mtu atakayejaribu kuchukua nchi yako.

decisions.choice: no one shall covet your land when you go up: God guards what is left behind
decisions.reason: Going to the feasts meant leaving farms and towns unguarded. God promises that no one will even desire to take the land while his people worship him.

decisions.choice: covet: desire with intent to take
decisions.reason: The verb is the one in the command "you shall not covet" (20:17). It means desire that leads to taking.

decisions.choice: scheme to seize
decisions.reason: Balanced brings out the intent in "covet"; Readable says "try to take".

source.text: לֹֽא־תִשְׁחַ֥ט עַל־חָמֵ֖ץ דַּם־זִבְחִ֑י וְלֹא־יָלִ֣ין לַבֹּ֔קֶר זֶ֖בַח חַ֥ג הַפָּֽסַח׃

records.literal_gloss: Not you must slaughter with leaven the blood of my sacrifice, and not will remain overnight to the morning [the] sacrifice of the festival of the Passover.

en.L: You shall not slaughter with leaven the blood of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sacrifice, and the sacrifice of the feast of the Passover shall not remain overnight until the morning.
en.B: When you slaughter a sacrifice for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, nothing leavened is to be offered with its blood. And nothing of the sacrifice of the Passover feast may be left over until morning.
en.R: When you offer an animal to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, do not offer any bread made with yeast at the same time. Do not keep any meat from the Passover sacrifice until the next morning.

es.L: No sacrificarás con levadura la sangre de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} sacrificio, y no pasará la noche hasta la mañana el sacrificio de la fiesta de la Pascua.
es.B: Cuando {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ofrezcas un sacrificio, no presentarás con su sangre nada que tenga levadura. Y nada del sacrificio de la fiesta de la Pascua quedará hasta la mañana.
es.R: Cuando {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ofrezcas un animal, no ofrezcas al mismo tiempo pan hecho con levadura. No guardes nada de la carne del sacrificio de la Pascua hasta la mañana siguiente.

fr.L: Tu n’immoleras pas avec du levain le sang de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} sacrifice, et le sacrifice de la fête de la Pâque ne passera pas la nuit jusqu’au matin.
fr.B: Quand tu {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}offriras un sacrifice, tu ne présenteras rien de levé avec son sang. Et rien du sacrifice de la fête de la Pâque ne restera jusqu’au matin.
fr.R: Quand tu {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}offres un animal, n’offre pas en même temps du pain fait avec de la levure. Ne garde pas de viande du sacrifice de la Pâque jusqu’au lendemain matin.

sw.L: Usichinje damu ya dhabihu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} pamoja na chachu, wala dhabihu ya sikukuu ya Pasaka isikae usiku kucha hadi asubuhi.
sw.B: Unaponichinjia dhabihu, kisitolewe kitu chochote kilichotiwa chachu pamoja na damu yake. Na kitu chochote cha dhabihu ya Sikukuu ya Pasaka kisibaki hadi asubuhi.
sw.R: Unaponitolea mnyama kuwa sadaka, usitoe wakati huo huo mkate uliotiwa chachu. Usiweke nyama yoyote ya dhabihu ya Pasaka mpaka asubuhi inayofuata.

decisions.choice: with leaven: leavened bread may not go with a sacrifice
decisions.reason: Leaven was kept from the altar (Leviticus 2:11). At Passover, above all, no leaven was to be present (12:15-20).

decisions.choice: not remain overnight until morning: the Passover meal is eaten that night
decisions.reason: As in 12:10, nothing of the Passover lamb was to be left until morning. Verse 25 repeats 23:18, here naming the Passover.

decisions.choice: leavened (Balanced); bread made with yeast (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in chapter 12: "leaven" at Literal and Balanced, "yeast" at Readable.

source.text: רֵאשִׁ֗ית בִּכּוּרֵי֙ אַדְמָ֣תְךָ֔ תָּבִ֕יא בֵּ֖ית יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ לֹא־תְבַשֵּׁ֥ל גְּדִ֖י בַּחֲלֵ֥ב אִמּֽוֹ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: The first of the first-fruits of your ground you will bring [to] the house of Yahweh your God. Not you will boil a kid in the milk of its mother.

en.L: The first of the firstfruits of your ground you shall bring [to] the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. You shall not boil a young goat in its mother's milk."
en.B: The choicest of the first produce from your land you are to bring into the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. Never boil a young goat in the milk of its own mother."
en.R: Bring the first and best crops from your fields to the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. Do not cook a young goat in the milk that came from its mother."

es.L: Lo primero de las primicias de tu tierra traerás [a la] casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios. No cocerás un cabrito en la leche de su madre.»
es.B: Lo más selecto de los primeros frutos de tu tierra lo llevarás a la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios. Nunca cocerás un cabrito en la leche de su propia madre.»
es.R: Lleva lo primero y lo mejor de las cosechas de tus campos a la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios. No cocines un cabrito en la leche que salió de su madre.»

fr.L: Les premières des prémices de ton sol, tu [les] apporteras [à la] maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu. Tu ne feras pas cuire un chevreau dans le lait de sa mère. »
fr.B: Le meilleur des premiers produits de ta terre, tu l’apporteras dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu. Tu ne feras jamais cuire un chevreau dans le lait de sa propre mère. »
fr.R: Apporte les premières et les meilleures récoltes de tes champs à la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu. Ne fais pas cuire un jeune chevreau dans le lait de sa mère. »

sw.L: Malimbuko ya kwanza ya ardhi yako utayaleta [katika] nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako. Usimtokose mwanambuzi katika maziwa ya mama yake."
sw.B: Yaliyo bora ya mazao ya kwanza ya nchi yako utayaleta katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako. Kamwe usimtokose mwanambuzi katika maziwa ya mama yake mwenyewe."
sw.R: Leta mazao ya kwanza na yaliyo bora ya mashamba yako katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako. Usimpike mwanambuzi katika maziwa yaliyotoka kwa mama yake."

decisions.choice: the first: the first and the best
decisions.reason: The word means the beginning of something and also its best part. The earliest and finest of the harvest belongs to God (23:19; Numbers 18:12-13).

decisions.choice: not boil a young goat in its mother's milk: the reason is not given
decisions.reason: The command appears three times (23:19; 34:26; Deuteronomy 14:21). The text does not say why. It may forbid a practice of other peoples' worship, or protect the bond between mother and young, as other laws do (Leviticus 22:28; Deuteronomy 22:6-7).

decisions.choice: the house of Yahweh: God's sanctuary
decisions.reason: The house of Yahweh is the place where he dwells among his people: at first the tabernacle (25:8-9), later the temple.

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה כְּתָב־לְךָ֖ אֶת־הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה כִּ֞י עַל־פִּ֣י׀הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה כָּרַ֧תִּי אִתְּךָ֛ בְּרִ֖ית וְאֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Yahweh to Moses, write for yourself these words, for on the mouth of these words I have made with you a covenant and with Israel.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to Moses, "Write for yourself these words, for according to the mouth of these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel."
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} told Moses, "Put these words in writing, for they are the terms on which I have made a covenant with you and with Israel."
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} told Moses, "Write down these words. They are the terms of the covenant I have made with you and with Israel."

es.L: Y dijo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} a Moisés: «Escribe para ti estas palabras, porque conforme a la boca de estas palabras he hecho un pacto contigo y con Israel.»
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo a Moisés: «Pon por escrito estas palabras, porque en estos términos he hecho un pacto contigo y con Israel.»
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo a Moisés: «Escribe estas palabras. Son las condiciones del pacto que he hecho contigo y con Israel.»

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Moïse : « Écris pour toi ces paroles, car c’est selon la bouche de ces paroles que j’ai conclu une alliance avec toi et avec Israël. »
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Moïse : « Mets ces paroles par écrit, car c’est sur ces termes que j’ai conclu une alliance avec toi et avec Israël. »
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit à Moïse : « Écris ces paroles. Ce sont les conditions de l’alliance que j’ai faite avec toi et avec Israël. »

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Musa, "Jiandikie maneno haya, kwa maana kwa kinywa cha maneno haya nimefanya agano nawe na Israeli."
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwambia Musa, "Yaandike maneno haya, kwa maana ndiyo masharti ambayo kwayo nimefanya agano nawe na Israeli."
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwambia Musa, "Andika maneno haya. Ndiyo masharti ya agano nililofanya nawe na Israeli."

decisions.choice: on the mouth of these words: in accordance with these words
decisions.reason: "According to the mouth of" means "on the terms of". The words of verses 10-26 set out what the renewed covenant requires.

decisions.choice: write these words: the covenant is put in writing
decisions.reason: When the covenant was first made, Moses wrote down God's words and read them to the people (24:4, 7). He is now to write the words of the renewed covenant.

decisions.choice: the terms
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the idiom. Literal keeps "according to the mouth of".

source.text: וַֽיְהִי־שָׁ֣ם עִם־יְהוָ֗ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים יוֹם֙ וְאַרְבָּעִ֣ים לַ֔יְלָה לֶ֚חֶם לֹ֣א אָכַ֔ל וּמַ֖יִם לֹ֣א שָׁתָ֑ה וַיִּכְתֹּ֣ב עַל־הַלֻּחֹ֗ת אֵ֚ת דִּבְרֵ֣י הַבְּרִ֔ית עֲשֶׂ֖רֶת הַדְּבָרִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And he was there with Yahweh forty day[s] and forty night[s]; food not he ate and water not he drank. And he wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the ten words.

en.L: And he was there with {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} forty days and forty nights; bread he did not eat and water he did not drink. And he wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the ten words.
en.B: Moses remained there with {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for forty days and forty nights; he ate no food and drank no water. And he wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the Ten Words.
en.R: Moses stayed there with {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for forty days and forty nights. During that time he did not eat any food or drink any water. And he wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the Ten Commandments.

es.L: Y estuvo allí con {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} cuarenta días y cuarenta noches; pan no comió y agua no bebió. Y escribió en las tablas las palabras del pacto, las diez palabras.
es.B: Moisés permaneció allí con {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} cuarenta días y cuarenta noches; no comió alimento ni bebió agua. Y escribió en las tablas las palabras del pacto, las Diez Palabras.
es.R: Moisés se quedó allí con {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} durante cuarenta días y cuarenta noches. En todo ese tiempo no comió nada ni bebió agua. Y escribió en las tablas las palabras del pacto, los Diez Mandamientos.

fr.L: Et il fut là avec {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} quarante jours et quarante nuits ; il ne mangea pas de pain et il ne but pas d’eau. Et il écrivit sur les tablettes les paroles de l’alliance, les dix paroles.
fr.B: Moïse demeura là avec {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} quarante jours et quarante nuits ; il ne mangea aucune nourriture et ne but pas d’eau. Et il écrivit sur les tablettes les paroles de l’alliance, les Dix Paroles.
fr.R: Moïse est resté là avec {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} pendant quarante jours et quarante nuits. Pendant tout ce temps, il n’a rien mangé et il n’a pas bu d’eau. Et il a écrit sur les tablettes les paroles de l’alliance, les Dix Commandements.

sw.L: Naye alikuwa huko pamoja na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} siku arobaini na usiku arobaini; mkate hakula na maji hakunywa. Akaandika juu ya vibao maneno ya agano, maneno kumi.
sw.B: Musa alikaa huko pamoja na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} siku arobaini na usiku arobaini; hakula chakula wala hakunywa maji. Akaandika juu ya vibao maneno ya agano, yale Maneno Kumi.
sw.R: Musa alikaa huko pamoja na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa siku arobaini, mchana na usiku. Wakati huo wote hakula chakula chochote wala hakunywa maji. Akaandika juu ya vibao maneno ya agano, zile Amri Kumi.

decisions.choice: he wrote: God, or Moses
decisions.reason: The verb has no named subject. In verse 1 God said, "I will write on the tablets", and Deuteronomy 10:2-4 says that God wrote the Ten Words on the second tablets. But Moses is the subject of the verbs just before, and in verse 27 God told him to write. The words Moses wrote may be those of verses 10-26, and the Ten Words those written by God.

decisions.choice: the ten words: the Ten Commandments
decisions.reason: This is the Hebrew name for the commands of 20:1-17 (Deuteronomy 4:13; 10:4). "Words" here means sayings or commands.

decisions.choice: forty days and forty nights without food or water: as on the first ascent
decisions.reason: Moses spent forty days and nights on the mountain before (24:18), and he fasted again when he interceded for Israel (Deuteronomy 9:9, 18). Elijah traveled forty days to the same mountain (1 Kings 19:8), and Jesus fasted forty days in the wilderness (Matthew 4:2).

decisions.choice: Moses
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "he was there"; Balanced and Readable name Moses. They leave "he wrote" unnamed, as the Hebrew does.

decisions.choice: the Ten Commandments
decisions.reason: Readable uses the familiar name. Literal and Balanced keep "ten words", the Hebrew name.

source.text: וַיְהִ֗י בְּרֶ֤דֶת מֹשֶׁה֙ מֵהַ֣ר סִינַ֔י וּשְׁנֵ֨י לֻחֹ֤ת הָֽעֵדֻת֙ בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁ֔ה בְּרִדְתּ֖וֹ מִן־הָהָ֑ר וּמֹשֶׁ֣ה לֹֽא־יָדַ֗ע כִּ֥י קָרַ֛ן ע֥וֹר פָּנָ֖יו בְּדַבְּר֥וֹ אִתּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was, when Moses came down from [the] mountain of Sinai, and the two tablets of the testimony [were] in [the] hand of Moses when he came down from the mountain, and Moses not he knew that it shone [the] skin of his face because he had spoken with him.

en.L: And it happened, when Moses came down from Mount Sinai, and the two tablets of the testimony [were] in the hand of Moses when he came down from the mountain, that Moses did not know that the skin of his face shone because he had spoken with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: Moses came down from Mount Sinai holding the two tablets of the testimony. As he descended the mountain, he was unaware that the skin of his face shone with rays of light, because he had been speaking with God.
en.R: Moses came down from Mount Sinai carrying the two stone tablets of the covenant. As he came down the mountain, he did not know that his face was shining, because he had been talking with God.

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando Moisés descendió del monte Sinaí, y las dos tablas del Testimonio [estaban] en la mano de Moisés cuando descendía del monte, Moisés no sabía que la piel de su rostro irradiaba por haber hablado con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.B: Moisés bajó del monte Sinaí llevando las dos tablas del Testimonio. Mientras descendía del monte, no se daba cuenta de que la piel de su rostro despedía rayos de luz, porque había estado hablando con Dios.
es.R: Moisés bajó del monte Sinaí con las dos tablas de piedra del pacto. Mientras bajaba del monte, no sabía que su cara brillaba, porque había estado hablando con Dios.

fr.L: Et il arriva, quand Moïse descendit du mont Sinaï, et les deux tablettes du Témoignage [étaient] dans la main de Moïse quand il descendit de la montagne, que Moïse ne savait pas que la peau de son visage rayonnait parce qu’il avait parlé avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: Moïse descendit du mont Sinaï en tenant les deux tablettes du Témoignage. Tandis qu’il descendait de la montagne, il ne savait pas que la peau de son visage jetait des rayons de lumière, parce qu’il avait parlé avec Dieu.
fr.R: Moïse est descendu du mont Sinaï en portant les deux tablettes de pierre de l’alliance. Pendant qu’il descendait de la montagne, il ne savait pas que son visage brillait, parce qu’il avait parlé avec Dieu.

sw.L: Ikawa, Musa aliposhuka kutoka mlima Sinai, na vile vibao viwili vya Ushuhuda [vilikuwa] mkononi mwa Musa aliposhuka kutoka mlimani, Musa hakujua kwamba ngozi ya uso wake ilitoa mionzi kwa sababu alikuwa amesema {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}.
sw.B: Musa alishuka kutoka mlima Sinai akiwa ameshika vile vibao viwili vya Ushuhuda. Alipokuwa akishuka mlimani, hakujua kwamba ngozi ya uso wake ilikuwa ikitoa mionzi ya nuru, kwa sababu alikuwa akizungumza na Mungu.
sw.R: Musa alishuka kutoka mlima Sinai akiwa amebeba vile vibao viwili vya mawe vya agano. Alipokuwa akishuka mlimani, hakujua kwamba uso wake ulikuwa ukiwaka kwa nuru, kwa sababu alikuwa amezungumza na Mungu.

decisions.choice: shone: sent out rays
decisions.reason: The verb comes from the noun for "horn" and is found only in this passage. It describes rays of light, like horns of light, shining from Moses' face (compare Habakkuk 3:4, where "rays" is the same noun). The Latin Vulgate read it as "horned", and that is why medieval and Renaissance art, including Michelangelo's statue of Moses, shows him with horns.

decisions.choice: the tablets of the testimony: the tablets of the covenant
decisions.reason: "The testimony" is the covenant written on the tablets, which bears witness to God's commands (25:16; 31:18).

decisions.choice: because he had spoken with him: the glory reflected from God
decisions.reason: Moses' face shone from being in God's presence; he had asked to see God's glory (33:18) and had seen it pass by (34:5-7). He did not know it himself.

decisions.choice: God
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "with him"; Balanced and Readable name God.

decisions.choice: the stone tablets of the covenant
decisions.reason: As in 31:18, Readable says what "the testimony" is.

decisions.choice: irradiaba (L); despedía rayos de luz (B)
decisions.reason: The verb pictures rays like horns of light (m1). "Irradiar" and "despedir rayos" keep the rays; Readable says plainly "brillaba".

decisions.choice: rayonnait (L); jetait des rayons de lumière (B)
decisions.reason: The verb pictures rays like horns of light (m1). "Rayonner" keeps the rays; Readable says plainly "brillait".

decisions.choice: ilitoa mionzi (L); ilikuwa ikitoa mionzi ya nuru (B)
decisions.reason: The verb pictures rays like horns of light (m1). "Kutoa mionzi" (to send out rays) keeps the picture; Readable says the face was shining with light.

source.text: וַיַּ֨רְא אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְכָל־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֥ה קָרַ֖ן ע֣וֹר פָּנָ֑יו וַיִּֽירְא֖וּ מִגֶּ֥שֶׁת אֵלָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And saw Aaron and all [the] sons of Israel Moses, and here! shone [the] skin of his face, and they were afraid of drawing near to him.

en.L: And Aaron and all the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel saw Moses, and look, the skin of his face shone! And they were afraid to come near him.
en.B: When Aaron and all the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} looked at Moses, there was the skin of his face, shining, and they feared to approach him.
en.R: Aaron and all the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} saw that Moses' face was shining. So they were afraid to go near him.

es.L: Y Aarón y todos los hijos de Israel vieron a Moisés, y he aquí, ¡la piel de su rostro irradiaba! Y tuvieron miedo de acercarse a él.
es.B: Cuando Aarón y todos los israelitas miraron a Moisés, vieron que la piel de su rostro resplandecía, y temieron acercarse a él.
es.R: Aarón y todos los israelitas vieron que la cara de Moisés brillaba. Por eso tuvieron miedo de acercarse a él.

fr.L: Et Aaron et tous les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël virent Moïse, et voici, la peau de son visage rayonnait ! Et ils eurent peur de s’approcher de lui.
fr.B: Quand Aaron et tous les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} regardèrent Moïse, voici que la peau de son visage rayonnait, et ils craignirent de s’approcher de lui.
fr.R: Aaron et tous les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} ont vu que le visage de Moïse brillait. Alors ils ont eu peur de s’approcher de lui.

sw.L: Haruni na wana wote wa Israeli wakamwona Musa, na tazama, ngozi ya uso wake ilitoa mionzi! Wakaogopa kumkaribia.
sw.B: Haruni na Waisraeli wote walipomtazama Musa, kumbe ngozi ya uso wake ilikuwa ikitoa mionzi, nao wakaogopa kumkaribia.
sw.R: Haruni na Waisraeli wote waliona kwamba uso wa Musa ulikuwa ukiwaka kwa nuru. Kwa hiyo wakaogopa kumkaribia.

decisions.choice: look, the skin of his face shone: what they saw
decisions.reason: "Look" puts the reader where Aaron and the people stood, seeing what Moses himself did not know.

decisions.choice: they were afraid to come near: fear before God's glory
decisions.reason: The people had been afraid to come near when God spoke from the mountain (20:18-21). Now they are afraid of the glory seen on Moses' face.

source.text: וַיִּקְרָ֤א אֲלֵהֶם֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַיָּשֻׁ֧בוּ אֵלָ֛יו אַהֲרֹ֥ן וְכָל־הַנְּשִׂאִ֖ים בָּעֵדָ֑ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֲלֵהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And summoned them Moses, and returned to him Aaron and all the leaders in the congregation, and spoke Moses to them.

en.L: And Moses called to them, and Aaron and all the leaders in the congregation returned to him, and Moses spoke to them.
en.B: Moses called them over, so Aaron came back to him, together with all the leaders of the community, and Moses spoke with them.
en.R: But Moses called to them. So Aaron and all the leaders of the community came back to him, and Moses talked with them.

es.L: Y Moisés los llamó, y Aarón y todos los jefes de la comunidad volvieron a él, y Moisés les habló.
es.B: Moisés los llamó, y Aarón volvió a él junto con todos los jefes de la comunidad, y Moisés habló con ellos.
es.R: Pero Moisés los llamó. Entonces Aarón y todos los jefes de la comunidad regresaron a donde estaba él, y Moisés habló con ellos.

fr.L: Et Moïse les appela, et Aaron et tous les chefs dans la communauté revinrent vers lui, et Moïse leur parla.
fr.B: Moïse les appela ; Aaron revint donc vers lui, avec tous les chefs de la communauté, et Moïse parla avec eux.
fr.R: Mais Moïse les a appelés. Alors Aaron et tous les chefs de la communauté sont revenus vers lui, et Moïse a parlé avec eux.

sw.L: Musa akawaita, na Haruni na viongozi wote katika jumuiya wakarudi kwake, naye Musa akasema nao.
sw.B: Musa aliwaita; basi Haruni akarudi kwake, pamoja na viongozi wote wa jumuiya, naye Musa akazungumza nao.
sw.R: Lakini Musa aliwaita. Basi Haruni na viongozi wote wa jumuiya wakarudi kwake, naye Musa akazungumza nao.

decisions.choice: leaders: chiefs of the tribes and clans
decisions.reason: The word means one who is lifted up, a leader or chief. It is used of the heads of the tribes (16:22; Numbers 1:16).

decisions.choice: congregation: the people gathered as a body
decisions.reason: The word means Israel as an assembled community (12:3; 16:1).

source.text: וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵ֥ן נִגְּשׁ֖וּ כָּל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיְצַוֵּ֕ם אֵת֩ כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אִתּ֖וֹ בְּהַ֥ר סִינָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And after thus drew near all [the] sons of Israel, and he commanded them all that had spoken Yahweh with him on [the] mountain of Sinai.

en.L: And afterward all the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel drew near, and he commanded them all that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had spoken with him on Mount Sinai.
en.B: After that all the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} came near, and Moses passed on to them as commands everything {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had told him on Mount Sinai.
en.R: Later all the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} came close too. Moses told them everything {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had said to him on Mount Sinai and ordered them to obey it.

es.L: Y después se acercaron todos los hijos de Israel, y él les mandó todo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había hablado con él en el monte Sinaí.
es.B: Después de esto se acercaron todos los israelitas, y Moisés les transmitió como mandatos todo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le había dicho en el monte Sinaí.
es.R: Más tarde todos los israelitas también se acercaron. Moisés les contó todo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le había dicho en el monte Sinaí y les ordenó que lo obedecieran.

fr.L: Et après cela, tous les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël s’approchèrent, et il leur commanda tout ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui avait dit sur le mont Sinaï.
fr.B: Après quoi tous les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} s’approchèrent, et Moïse leur transmit comme des ordres tout ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui avait dit sur le mont Sinaï.
fr.R: Ensuite, tous les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} se sont approchés eux aussi. Moïse leur a dit tout ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui avait dit sur le mont Sinaï, et il leur a ordonné d’y obéir.

sw.L: Na baadaye wana wote wa Israeli wakakaribia, naye akawaamuru yote ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amesema naye katika mlima Sinai.
sw.B: Baada ya hayo Waisraeli wote walikaribia, naye Musa akawapa kama amri yote ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amemwambia katika mlima Sinai.
sw.R: Baadaye Waisraeli wote nao walikaribia. Musa akawaeleza yote ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amemwambia katika mlima Sinai, akawaagiza wayatii.

decisions.choice: all that Yahweh had spoken with him: the commands of verses 10-27
decisions.reason: Moses passes on the words of the renewed covenant, as he passed on God's words before (19:7; 24:3).

decisions.choice: Moses
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "he commanded"; Balanced and Readable name Moses.

source.text: וַיְכַ֣ל מֹשֶׁ֔ה מִדַּבֵּ֖ר אִתָּ֑ם וַיִּתֵּ֥ן עַל־פָּנָ֖יו מַסְוֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And finished Moses from speaking with them, and he put over his face a veil.

en.L: And Moses finished speaking with them, and he put a veil on his face.
en.B: Once Moses was done speaking with them, he covered his face with a veil.
en.R: After Moses finished talking with them, he covered his face with a cloth.

es.L: Y acabó Moisés de hablar con ellos, y puso sobre su rostro un velo.
es.B: Cuando Moisés terminó de hablar con ellos, se cubrió el rostro con un velo.
es.R: Después de hablar con ellos, Moisés se tapó la cara con una tela.

fr.L: Et Moïse acheva de parler avec eux, et il mit un voile sur son visage.
fr.B: Lorsque Moïse eut fini de leur parler, il se couvrit le visage d’un voile.
fr.R: Après avoir parlé avec eux, Moïse a couvert son visage avec un tissu.

sw.L: Musa akamaliza kusema nao, akaweka utaji juu ya uso wake.
sw.B: Musa alipomaliza kuzungumza nao, alifunika uso wake kwa utaji.
sw.R: Musa alipomaliza kuzungumza nao, alifunika uso wake kwa kitambaa.

decisions.choice: veil: a covering for the face
decisions.reason: The word is found only in this passage and means a covering. It is a different word from the veil of the tabernacle (26:31).

decisions.choice: finished speaking ... put a veil: the veil came after he spoke
decisions.reason: Moses spoke to the people with his face uncovered and put the veil on when he had finished. Verses 34-35 describe what he did each time.

decisions.choice: cloth
decisions.reason: Readable says "cloth", a plain word for the covering.

source.text: וּבְבֹ֨א מֹשֶׁ֜ה לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ לְדַבֵּ֣ר אִתּ֔וֹ יָסִ֥יר אֶת־הַמַּסְוֶ֖ה עַד־צֵאת֑וֹ וְיָצָ֗א וְדִבֶּר֙ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֵ֖ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְצֻוֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And when went Moses before Yahweh to speak with him, he removed the veil until he came out. And he came out and spoke to [the] sons of Israel that which he was commanded.

en.L: And when Moses went in before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to speak with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, he would remove the veil until he came out; and he would come out and speak to the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel what he had been commanded.
en.B: Each time Moses went into the presence of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to talk with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, he kept the veil off until he came out again. Then he would come out and tell the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} what he had been commanded to say.
en.R: Every time Moses went in to meet with {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, he took off the cloth. He kept it off until he came out. Then he told the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} what he had been told to say.

es.L: Y cuando Moisés entraba delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} para hablar con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, se quitaba el velo hasta que salía; y salía y decía a los hijos de Israel lo que le había sido mandado.
es.B: Cada vez que Moisés entraba a la presencia {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} para hablar con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, se quitaba el velo hasta que volvía a salir. Luego salía y comunicaba a los israelitas lo que se le había ordenado decir.
es.R: Cada vez que Moisés entraba a encontrarse con {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, se quitaba la tela. No se la volvía a poner hasta que salía. Luego les decía a los israelitas lo que le habían mandado decir.

fr.L: Et quand Moïse entrait devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} pour parler avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, il ôtait le voile jusqu’à ce qu’il sorte ; et il sortait et disait aux {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël ce qui lui avait été ordonné.
fr.B: Chaque fois que Moïse entrait en présence {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} pour s’entretenir avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, il gardait le voile ôté jusqu’à ce qu’il ressorte. Puis il sortait et disait aux {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} ce qu’il avait reçu l’ordre de leur dire.
fr.R: Chaque fois que Moïse entrait pour rencontrer {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, il enlevait le tissu. Il le gardait enlevé jusqu’à ce qu’il sorte. Ensuite, il disait aux {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} ce qu’on lui avait dit de leur dire.

sw.L: Na Musa alipoingia mbele ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kusema {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}, aliuondoa utaji hadi alipotoka; naye alitoka na kuwaambia wana wa Israeli yale aliyoamriwa.
sw.B: Kila mara Musa alipoingia mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kuzungumza {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}, aliuondoa utaji mpaka alipotoka tena. Kisha alikuwa akitoka na kuwaambia Waisraeli yale aliyoamriwa kusema.
sw.R: Kila mara Musa alipoingia kukutana na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, alikivua kitambaa. Hakukivaa tena mpaka alipotoka. Kisha aliwaambia Waisraeli yale aliyoambiwa awaambie.

decisions.choice: he would remove ... he would come out and speak: what Moses did each time
decisions.reason: The verbs describe a regular practice, not one event. Each time Moses met with God, he went in uncovered and came out to speak to the people.

decisions.choice: went before Yahweh: went into God's presence
decisions.reason: This most likely means the tent of meeting, where Moses spoke with God "face to face" (33:7-11).

decisions.choice: ôtait, sortait, disait (imparfait)
decisions.reason: The verbs describe what Moses did each time (m1), so French uses the imperfect, the tense of habit, at every level, instead of the narrative passé simple or passé composé.

source.text: וְרָא֤וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת־פְּנֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה כִּ֣י קָרַ֔ן ע֖וֹר פְּנֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֑ה וְהֵשִׁ֨יב מֹשֶׁ֤ה אֶת־הַמַּסְוֶה֙ עַל־פָּנָ֔יו עַד־בֹּא֖וֹ לְדַבֵּ֥ר אִתּֽוֹ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And saw [the] sons of Israel the face of Moses, that shone [the] skin of [the] face of Moses, and put back Moses the veil over his face until he went to speak with him.

en.L: And the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel would see the face of Moses, that the skin of the face of Moses shone, and Moses would put the veil back on his face until he went in to speak with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: The {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} saw the light shining from the skin of Moses' face, and Moses would cover his face with the veil again until he went in to speak with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: The {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} could see that Moses' face was shining. Then Moses would cover his face with the cloth again until he went back in to talk with God.

es.L: Y los hijos de Israel veían el rostro de Moisés, que la piel del rostro de Moisés irradiaba, y Moisés volvía a poner el velo sobre su rostro hasta que entraba a hablar con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.B: Los israelitas veían la luz que irradiaba de la piel del rostro de Moisés, y Moisés volvía a cubrirse el rostro con el velo hasta que entraba de nuevo a hablar con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.R: Los israelitas podían ver que la cara de Moisés brillaba. Después Moisés volvía a taparse la cara con la tela hasta que entraba otra vez a hablar con Dios.

fr.L: Et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël voyaient le visage de Moïse, que la peau du visage de Moïse rayonnait, et Moïse remettait le voile sur son visage jusqu’à ce qu’il entre pour parler avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: Les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} voyaient la lumière qui rayonnait de la peau du visage de Moïse, et Moïse se couvrait de nouveau le visage du voile jusqu’à ce qu’il rentre parler avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.R: Les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} pouvaient voir que le visage de Moïse brillait. Ensuite Moïse se couvrait de nouveau le visage avec le tissu jusqu’à ce qu’il retourne parler avec Dieu.

sw.L: Na wana wa Israeli waliuona uso wa Musa, kwamba ngozi ya uso wa Musa ilitoa mionzi, naye Musa aliurudisha utaji juu ya uso wake mpaka alipoingia kusema {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}.
sw.B: Waisraeli waliiona nuru ikitoka katika ngozi ya uso wa Musa, naye Musa alikuwa akiufunika uso wake tena kwa utaji mpaka alipoingia tena kuzungumza {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}.
sw.R: Waisraeli waliweza kuona kwamba uso wa Musa ulikuwa ukiwaka kwa nuru. Kisha Musa alikuwa akiufunika uso wake tena kwa kitambaa mpaka alipoingia tena kuzungumza na Mungu.

decisions.choice: the veil over Moses' face: read in 2 Corinthians 3
decisions.reason: Paul reads this passage in 2 Corinthians 3:7-18. He says the glory on Moses' face was fading and the veil kept Israel from seeing its end. He compares it to a veil over hearts when the old covenant is read, which is taken away when one turns to the Lord, so that believers with unveiled faces see the glory of the Lord and are changed.

decisions.choice: put back the veil until he went in: why Moses wore the veil
decisions.reason: The text does not say why Moses covered his face. The order of events is clear: his face was uncovered when he spoke God's words and before God, and covered between those times.

decisions.choice: God
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "with him"; Readable names God.
